xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex: As on 31.12.2025, the Board comprised of 7 Whole Time Directors (including Chairman), 1 Government Nominee Director and 3 Independent Directors. Considering the compliance requirement of atleast 50% of Independent Directors of the Board composition, there was a shortfall of five (5) Independent Directors. Accordingly, the MoPNG, Government of India, has been requested vide letters dated 19.12.2025 and 11.09.2025 to fill the requisite number of Independent Directors. ONGC is a Government Company and power of appointment of directors (including Independent Director) is vested with the Govt. of India (GoI). A provision in this regard is also contained in the Articles of Association of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: ONGC filed the application for subscription of 10,00,00,000 (Ten Crore) equity shares of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten) on 12.11.2025 and transferred the subscription money of Rs.100,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Hundred Crore only) to the Bank Account of ONGC Green Limited (OGL) on 14.11.2025. Accordingly, OGL allotted shares to ONGC on 19.12.2025.

(1) The Company received demand orders from GST and Service Tax Department at various work centres on account of GST and Service Tax on Royalty in respect of Crude Oil and Natural Gas. Appeals against such orders have been filed before various Tribunals/ Courts.
(2) The company received demand order from GST Department, Rajasthan, for non-payment of GST on Royalty for JV partners share in unincorporated Joint Venture (UJV) for the period 01.04.2020 to 14.05.2020 However, the company is paying GST under protest for its own share of PI in UJV. Writ petition has been filed against the demand order in Jodhpur High Court, which is pending for consideration.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeals are pending before the Hon'ble Courts/ Tribunals.
